H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H6098: advice; by implication, plan; also prudence
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H2400: a criminal, or one accounted guilty
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H4186: a seat; figuratively, a site; abstractly, a session; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication, population
H3887: properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H8451: a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H2656: pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind)
H1897: to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H6388: a rill (i.e. small channel of water, as in irrigation)
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
H5929: a leaf (as coming up on a tree); collectively, foliage
H5034: to wilt; generally, to fall away, fail, faint; figuratively, to be foolish or (morally) wicked; causatively, to despise, disgrace
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H6743: to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H4671: chaff (as pressed out, i.e. winnowed or (rather) threshed loose)
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H5712: a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd)
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
